title: A1
query: What is the functional domain associated with EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasOtherName RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName    OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasOtherName RETURN DISTINCT fd.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomain, fd.uri AS functionalDomainUri;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR" RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'})-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A2
query: What are the amino acid changes and mutation descriptions for EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR" OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = "EGFR" MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName AS hasPrimaryName, m.hasMutationDescription AS hasMutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, [])    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, []) RETURN DISTINCT   p.hasPrimaryName AS protein,   m.hasWildTypeResidue + toString(m.hasStartLocation) + coalesce(m.hasMutantType, '') AS amino_acid_change,   m.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description ORDER BY amino_acid_change
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR" MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) RETURN m.hasAminoAcidChange AS aminoAcidChange, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "EGFR"})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN m.hasWildTypeResidue AS hasWildTypeResidue,        m.hasMutationDescription AS hasMutationDescription UNION MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "EGFR"})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:OtherMutation) RETURN m.hasMutationAA AS hasWildTypeResidue,        m.hasMutationDescription AS hasMutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: A3
query: In which organisms is DCLK1 protein present?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'DCLK1'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'DCLK1'    OR p.hasFullName = 'DCLK1'    OR 'DCLK1' IN p.hasOtherName    OR 'DCLK1' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE toUpper(p.hasPrimaryName) = 'DCLK1'    OR toUpper(p.hasUniprotPrimaryName) = 'DCLK1'    OR toUpper(p.hasFullName) CONTAINS 'DCLK1'    OR ANY(name IN COALESCE(p.hasOtherName, []) WHERE toUpper(name) CONTAINS 'DCLK1')    OR ANY(name IN COALESCE(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) WHERE toUpper(name) CONTAINS 'DCLK1') RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName AS organism, o.hasScientificName AS scientific_name ORDER BY organism, scientific_name;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "DCLK1" RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "DCLK1"})-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A4
query: What pathways does EGFR protein participate in?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasOtherName    OR 'EGFR' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName RETURN pathway.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, [])    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, []) RETURN DISTINCT pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathway ORDER BY pathway;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR" RETURN pathway.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN pathway.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A5
query: What reactions are produced by the 'RHOJ GTPase cycle' pathway?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'})-[:HASREACTION]-(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName AS reaction ORDER BY reaction;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Pathway {hasPrimaryName: 'RHOJ GTPase cycle'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

query: List all proteins belonging to the EGFR family.

ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) RETURN DISTINCT p.hasPrimaryName AS protein, p.hasFullName AS fullName, p.uri AS uri ORDER BY protein
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) RETURN DISTINCT p.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: A7
query: What is the tissue specificity of the EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR' OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) RETURN p.hasTissueSpecificity LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, [])    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS protein, p.hasTissueSpecificity AS tissueSpecificity;

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN p.hasTissueSpecificity LIMIT 100

title: A8
query: What is the chromosomal position of the EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR' OR p.hasOtherName CONTAINS 'EGFR' OR p.hasUniprotSynonymName CONTAINS 'EGFR' RETURN p.chromosomalPosition LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, [])    OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS protein, p.chromosomalPosition AS chromosomalPosition;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "EGFR"})-[:HASDBXREF]->(d:DbXref) WHERE d.chromosomalPosition IS NOT NULL RETURN d.chromosomalPosition LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN p.chromosomalPosition LIMIT 100

title: A9
query: Is HIPK1 protein a dark kinase?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'HIPK1'    OR p.hasFullName = 'HIPK1'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'HIPK1'    OR 'HIPK1' IN p.hasOtherName    OR 'HIPK1' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName RETURN p.isDarkKinase LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE toUpper(p.hasPrimaryName) = 'HIPK1'    OR toUpper(p.hasUniprotPrimaryName) = 'HIPK1'    OR toUpper(p.hasFullName) CONTAINS 'HIPK1'    OR 'HIPK1' IN [x IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) | toUpper(x)]    OR 'HIPK1' IN [x IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, []) | toUpper(x)] RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS protein, p.isDarkKinase AS isDarkKinase;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "HIPK1"})-[:TYPE]->(c:Class) WHERE toLower(c.hasPrimaryName) CONTAINS "dark" RETURN c.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'HIPK1' RETURN p.isDarkKinase LIMIT 100

title: A10
query: What is the cellular location of the BRAF protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'BRAF' OR p.hasOtherName CONTAINS 'BRAF' OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName CONTAINS 'BRAF' OR p.hasUniprotSynonymName CONTAINS 'BRAF' RETURN p.hasCellularLocation LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE toUpper(p.hasPrimaryName) = 'BRAF'    OR toUpper(p.hasUniprotPrimaryName) = 'BRAF'    OR toUpper(p.hasFullName) CONTAINS 'BRAF'    OR ANY(name IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, []) WHERE toUpper(name) CONTAINS 'BRAF')    OR ANY(name IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) WHERE toUpper(name) CONTAINS 'BRAF') RETURN p.hasPrimaryName AS protein, p.hasCellularLocation AS cellularLocation;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "BRAF"}) MATCH (p)-[:INCLUDES]->(o:Organelle) RETURN o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' RETURN p.hasCellularLocation LIMIT 100

title: B1
query: What are the sequence motifs found in the amino acid sequence of the EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR' OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR' OR 'EGFR' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR"    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS "EGFR"    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName CONTAINS "EGFR"    OR "EGFR" IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, [])    OR "EGFR" IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, []) RETURN DISTINCT   p.hasPrimaryName AS protein,   s.hasPrimaryName AS sequence,   m.hasPrimaryName AS motif,   m.hasMotifSequence AS motif_sequence,   m.hasStartLocation AS start_location,   m.hasEndLocation AS end_location,   m.hasPKAStartLocation AS pka_start_location,   m.hasPKAEndLocation AS pka_end_location ORDER BY start_location, motif;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "EGFR"})-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'EGFR'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: B2
query: Which sample is associated with the gene expression of EGFR protein?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (ge)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasFullName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR p.hasOtherName CONTAINS 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotSynonymName CONTAINS 'EGFR' RETURN s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)<-[:HASPROTEIN]-(ge:GeneExpression)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasUniprotSynonymName = 'EGFR'    OR p.hasOtherName = 'EGFR' RETURN DISTINCT s.hasIdSample AS sampleId, s.hasSampleName AS sampleName
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (g:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (g)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN s.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (ge)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR' RETURN s.hasSampleName AS sample LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain),       (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = "EGFR"   AND o.hasPrimaryName = "Human" RETURN DISTINCT fd.hasPrimaryName AS functionalDomain, fd.uri AS uri ORDER BY functionalDomain
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'   AND o.hasPrimaryName = 'Human' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'EGFR'   AND o.hasPrimaryName = 'Human' RETURN fd.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE toLower(s.primarySite) = 'skin' RETURN DISTINCT s.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'DCLK3'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) WHERE s.hasPrimarySite = 'skin' RETURN DISTINCT s.hasSampleName LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "IRAK1"}) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) MATCH (li:LigandInteraction)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m) MATCH (li)-[:HASLIGAND]->(l:Ligand) OPTIONAL MATCH (li)-[:TYPE]->(c:Class) RETURN DISTINCT l.hasPrimaryName AS Ligand, c.hasPrimaryName AS InteractionType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: "IRAK1"}) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) MATCH (li:LigandInteraction)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m) MATCH (li)-[:HASLIGAND]->(l:Ligand) RETURN DISTINCT l.hasPrimaryName, li.hasType LIMIT 100

title: C3

ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (s:Sample)-[:INSAMPLE]-(ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]-(p:Protein),       (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]-(c:Cancer) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3'   AND ge.hasRegulation = 'under' RETURN s.hasSampleName AS sample_name,        ge.hasRegulation AS regulation,        c.hasPrimaryName AS cancer_type ORDER BY sample_name, cancer_type;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (ge)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3'   AND toLower(ge.regulation) CONTAINS 'under' RETURN s.hasPrimaryName AS sample, ge.regulation AS regulation, c.hasPrimaryName AS cancer LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (ge)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'AKT3'   AND ge.hasRegulation = 'under' RETURN s.hasSampleName AS sample_name,        ge.hasRegulation AS regulation,        c.hasPrimaryName AS cancer_type LIMIT 100

title: C4
query: Which sequence motifs are found in proteins belonging to the EGFR family?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN DISTINCT m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN DISTINCT   m.hasPrimaryName AS sequenceMotif,   m.hasMotifSequence AS motifSequence,   m.hasStartLocation AS startLocation,   m.hasEndLocation AS endLocation,   m.hasPKAStartLocation AS pkaStartLocation,   m.hasPKAEndLocation AS pkaEndLocation ORDER BY sequenceMotif
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN DISTINCT m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (f:EGFRfamily)-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(s:Sequence) MATCH (s)-[:HASMOTIF]->(m:SequenceMotif) RETURN DISTINCT m.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: C5
query: What are the histology subtypes of cancers linked to samples that have proteins with mutation ID 'COSM4166151'?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE m.hasMutationId = 'COSM4166151' RETURN DISTINCT c.hasHistologySubType LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense {hasMutationId: 'COSM4166151'}),       (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) RETURN DISTINCT c.hasHistologySubType AS histologySubtype ORDER BY histologySubtype;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE m.mutationId = 'COSM4166151' RETURN DISTINCT c.histologySubtype LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:OtherMutation) WHERE m.hasMutationId = 'COSM4166151' MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) RETURN DISTINCT c.hasHistologySubType LIMIT 100

title: C6
query: What is the name of the organism for proteins belonging to the Plant clade?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) MATCH (o)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade) WHERE c.hasPrimaryName = 'Plant' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade {hasPrimaryName: 'Plant'}) RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName AS organism_name
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) MATCH (o)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade) WHERE c.hasPrimaryName = "Plant" RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) MATCH (o)-[:ISPARTOF]->(c:Clade) WHERE c.hasPrimaryName = 'Plant' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: C7
query: Find pathways that include proteins containing the functional domain 'PI3_PI4_kinase' and have mutations. Please provide the names of these pathways and descriptions of the mutations.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase' MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathway, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription UNION MATCH (fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase' MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:OtherMutation) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathway, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]-(prot:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain {hasPrimaryName: 'PI3_PI4_kinase'}) MATCH (prot)-[:HASMUTATION]->(mut) WHERE mut:Missense OR mut:OtherMutation RETURN DISTINCT   p.hasPrimaryName AS pathway_name,   mut.hasMutationDescription AS mutation_description ORDER BY pathway_name, mutation_description;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase'   AND (m:Missense OR m:Deletion OR m:Insertion OR m:Nonsense OR m:OtherMutation) RETURN DISTINCT pw.hasPrimaryName AS pathway, m.description AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'PI3_PI4_kinase' MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) WHERE m:Missense OR m:OtherMutation OR m:InsertionFrameshift OR m:DeletionFrameshift OR m:CodingSilent OR m:Nonsense OR m:InsertionInframe OR m:DeletionInframe OR m:ComplexFrameshift OR m:ComplexDeletionInframe OR m:CompoundSubstitution OR m:ComplexInsertionInframe RETURN DISTINCT pathway.hasPrimaryName AS pathway, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: C8
query: List the organisms that have proteins containing the functional domain 'Cadherin'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain),       (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName AS organism, o.hasScientificName AS scientificName ORDER BY organism;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:HASFUNCTIONALDOMAIN]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (p)-[:PRESENTIN]->(o:Organism) WHERE fd.hasPrimaryName = 'Cadherin' RETURN DISTINCT o.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100

title: C9
query: Which mutations of the protein 'BRAF' associated with samples implicated in 'carcinoma_blastoma'? Please provide the mutation IDs and mutation descriptions.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.hasMutationId AS mutationId, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:HASMUTATION]->(m:Missense)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE c.hasCancerName = 'carcinoma_blastoma' OR c.hasName = 'carcinoma_blastoma' RETURN DISTINCT m.hasMutationId AS mutationId,        m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription ORDER BY mutationId;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE c.hasPrimaryName = 'carcinoma_blastoma' RETURN DISTINCT m.hasPrimaryName, m.description LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'}) MATCH (p)-[:HASMUTATION]->(m) MATCH (m)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample) MATCH (s)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer {hasPrimaryName: 'carcinoma_blastoma'}) WHERE (   m:Missense OR   m:OtherMutation OR   m:InsertionFrameshift OR   m:DeletionFrameshift OR   m:CodingSilent OR   m:Nonsense OR   m:InsertionInframe OR   m:DeletionInframe OR   m:ComplexFrameshift OR   m:ComplexDeletionInframe OR   m:CompoundSubstitution OR   m:ComplexInsertionInframe ) RETURN DISTINCT m.hasMutationId AS mutationId, m.hasMutationDescription AS mutationDescription LIMIT 100

title: C10
query: What are the reactions associated with pathways in which BRAF protein participates?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' OR p.hasFullName = 'BRAF' OR 'BRAF' IN p.hasOtherName OR 'BRAF' IN p.hasUniprotSynonymName OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'BRAF' MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (pw)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) RETURN pw.hasPrimaryName AS Pathway, r.hasPrimaryName AS Reaction LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(path:Pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF'    OR p.hasFullName = 'BRAF'    OR p.hasUniprotPrimaryName = 'BRAF'    OR 'BRAF' IN coalesce(p.hasOtherName, [])    OR 'BRAF' IN coalesce(p.hasUniprotSynonymName, []) RETURN DISTINCT path.hasPrimaryName AS pathway, r.hasPrimaryName AS reaction ORDER BY pathway, reaction;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (pw)-[:HASREACTION]->(r:Reaction) WHERE p.hasPrimaryName = 'BRAF' RETURN DISTINCT r.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'BRAF'})-[:PARTICIPATESIN]->(pathway:Pathway) MATCH (pathway)-[:HASREACTION]->(reaction:Reaction) RETURN DISTINCT reaction.hasPrimaryName LIMIT 100
